snippet.title: Trainfort - Reveal Trailer | Open-World Co-op Survival Crafting | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Join the playtest ! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593980/Trainfort/ 

Trainfort is an open-world co-op survival crafting game. As a dwarf nomad, hit the road of this post-apocalyptic world with your bearded mates. Build a moving steam engine, pack your base with you, and explore the wilderness. 

Join the community
x : https://x.com/trainfortgame
Discord: https://discord.gg/zq8q5VUhh7
